items.label: 【Thoughtful 3Pcs Set】
items.value: Come with 1 purse for women, 1 crossbody bag for women, 1 wallet (17 card holders). Please know that the hobo bag for women(the smaller shoulder handbag) cannot be zippered if you put the wallet in(Brown)

items: 【Large Capacity & Multi-Pockets】The biggest crossbody bag measures 12.2” x 5.1” x 12.2”. A zippered compartment divides the roomy bag into two parts. 6 pockets to organize your different things well. The purse bag for women is 9” x 3.9” x 9” . 1 main pocket with zipper, 1 front open pocket with magnetic clasp and 1 back zippered pocket. The wallet is 8.5” x 1” x 4.5”
【Detachable & Adjustable Guitar Straps】The two crossbody handbags are equipped with gold metal clip attachments which you can change the strap you like. The guitar strap is adjustable, measuring 51”

【Multi-Functional Use】The spacious tote and sling bag offer ample room for essentials. You can carry the sling bag wherever you go. Ideal for working, shopping, dating, traveling... And also it is a good choice to give the hobo bag as a gift on birthday and all kinds of holidays
【PU Leather & Soft】The purses set are made of soft PU leather and have precise workmanship. 3pcs in 1 set, very accessible and thoughtful to meet your different needs
